messages:
Alex P.: planning a careful blue->green traffic shift for router-edge v2.4.5 -> v2.5.0 during the 01:45 UTC change window. change: token bucket limiter + conn-pool tuning.
Rohan S.: noted. ramp profile?
Alex P.: 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%. 5m holds on first two, 10m on last. abort if p95 > 2x baseline for 10m OR 5xx > 2% sustained.
Clara V.: session affinity=cookie. will pin for 30m after full shift. prewarming caches now.
deploy-bot: preflight ok: green pool=4, configs linted, healthchecks pass.
Alex P.: publishing ops note. starting 3% siphon in 2m.
deploy-bot: Step 1: shifted 3% to green (v2.5.0).
Rohan S.: p95 +3ms, errors unchanged.
Clara V.: cache hit rate ~85% on green.
Alex P.: proceeding to 20% in 6m if metrics stable.
deploy-bot: Step 2: shifted 20% to green.
Rohan S.: transient 502s on node-2 (8 in 3m). investigating.
Alex P.: pausing ramp. Clara, can you check connection limits on node-2?
Clara V.: found one worker hitting max_fds, restarted worker; 502s dropped after restart.
deploy-bot: node-2 worker restart logged. healthchecks green.
Rohan S.: metrics settled. error rate 1.1%, p95 50ms. below abort.
Alex P.: advancing to 60% but will slow the next step.
deploy-bot: Step 3: shifted 60% to green.
Rohan S.: steady. no new spikes.
Clara V.: affinity stable, pin set post-shift.
Alex P.: final to 100% in 10m if steady.
deploy-bot: Step 4: shifted 100% to green. config-store pinned router-edge=v2.5.0.
Rohan S.: p95 52ms, errors 0.9%. all good.
Alex P.: creating follow-up ticket to harden fd limits and add pre-shift worker healthcheck. thanks team. :tada:
